name: Raw-meal moduli (LSF, SM, AM) with target bands
use_case: One small panel per modulus; shaded target window supplied by the user.
origin_hint: Origin: three Column layers; target band = Insert > Rectangle in axis units.
calculations: LSF = CaO/(2.8SiO2+1.18Al2O3+0.65Fe2O3); SM = SiO2/(Al2O3+Fe2O3); AM = Al2O3/Fe2O3
label_policy: labels/peak names only from user files or user confirmation
